reason: A Feishu/Lark integration that remotely orchestrates DeepSeek Harness agents by receiving chat tasks, running them, and returning text or image results.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书或 Lark 接收聊天任务、运行 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，并将文本或图片结果返回聊天会话。
summaries.en: Remotely orchestrate DeepSeek Harness agents through Feishu or Lark by receiving chat tasks and returning text or image results.

capabilities: Receives Feishu/Lark direct-message events over a WebSocket long connection
Creates and runs DeepSeek Harness agent tasks from incoming messages
Sends text messages and local images to Feishu users or chats
Downloads URLs and Feishu image resources to local files
Uses a vision model to analyze received images
Runs a detached, unsandboxed resident listener process
